name: Earth Sciences Minor

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must obtain a C- grade or better in all EASC and prerequisite courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In addition, a program GPA of 2.0 must be obtained on the overall course work (CGPA) as well as on the upper division subset of that work (UDGPA) in the program area.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of 15 units of upper division EASC courses, together with all prerequisites for those courses, excluding EASC 491, EASC 492, EASC 493, and EASC 498.

sections.note:
Students are subject to the general regulations of the faculty in which they are enrolled.
Students are encouraged to select their lower division courses in consultation with an advisor to ensure that prerequisites for desired upper division courses are met.
An advisor can also suggest combinations of courses in different areas of environmental geoscience and geology.
